Human Resource Specialist Job at Lily hospitals Limited




        
    

        
        Lily hospitals Limited, established since 1986 remains one of the foremost hospitals in Nigeria and within the South-South region of the country. It is the first private hospital in Nigeria to achieve ISO 9001:2000 quality management system certification from the Standards Organization of Nigeria (SON). Also we areconsistently committed to high standards; continuous improvement, service excellence, organizational citizenship, and outstanding work ethics.
     

            
    



At Lily hospitals, weare consistently committed to high standards; continuous improvement, service excellence, organizational citizenship, and outstanding work ethics. running residency training programs in family medicine and radiology. Lily Hospitals is also involved in housemanship training, internship training in Pharmacy and Radiology. We have multiple locations in Benin, Warri, Okuokoko etc.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Human Resource Specialist

Job Location: Warri, Delta
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking a highly organized and experiencedHR Specialistto support and drive key Human Resources functions, including recruitment, employee relations, performance management, learning and development, HR compliance, and policy implementation.
	The ideal candidate will contribute to fostering a positive work environment while ensuring HR best practices align with organizational objectives.


Key Responsibilities


	Manage end-to-end recruitment and selection processes.
	Coordinate onboarding, orientation, and employee documentation.
	Maintain accurate employee records and HR databases.
	Support performance management and employee appraisal processes.
	Handle employee relations issues and provide guidance on HR policies.
	Coordinate learning and development initiatives.
	Ensure compliance with labour laws, company policies, and HR best practices.
	Prepare HR reports, metrics, and workforce analytics.
	Support compensation and benefits administration.
	Assist with disciplinary and grievance procedures.
	Participate in HR projects and process improvement initiatives.
	Perform other HR-related duties as assigned.


Requirements


	Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
	5 years of relevant HR experience in a structured organization.
	Must possess professional HR certification (CIPM, SHRM, HRCI, etc.)
	Strong knowledge of HR operations, labor laws, and people management practices.
	Experience in performance management, recruitment, policy development, and compensation
	administration.
	Excellent communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR systems/tools.


Benefits


	Competitive salary package
	Health Insurance /HMO
	Professional growth and training opportunities
	Collaborative and professional work environment
	Performance-based rewards and recognition.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV, result, NYSC certificate (if applicable) and any other related documents to: [email protected] using “Application as a Human Resource Specialist, Warri” as the subject of the email.

Account / Admin Assistant Job at Dynamic Edge Business Venture




        
    

        
        Dynamic Edge Business venture is an arm of Ajoke Group that deals with the distribution of Cadbury products.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account / Admin Assistant

Job Locations: Gbagada / Bariga / Oworo / Somolu, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Assist the Accountant with daily accounting and financial record-keeping activities.
	Record and update financial transactions, payments, receipts, and expenses accurately.
	Prepare invoices, receipts, payment vouchers, and other accounting documents.
	Assist with bank reconciliation, petty cash management, and expense tracking.
	Monitor and follow up on outstanding payments and customer balances.
	Maintain accurate records of sales, purchases, expenses, and other financial transactions.
	Assist in preparing daily, weekly, and monthly financial reports.
	Verify invoices, receipts, and supporting documents before processing payments.
	Maintain proper filing and documentation of accounting and administrative records.
	Provide general administrative support to the office and assist with routine office coordination.
	Manage correspondence, documentation, and other office records as required.
	Assist in monitoring office supplies and ensuring timely replenishment.
	Support the HR/Admin department with attendance records, staff documentation, and other administrative tasks when required.
	Liaise with customers, suppliers, and other relevant parties professionally when necessary.
	Perform any other accounting or administrative duties assigned by management.


Requirements


	Interested candidates should possess relevant qualifications and experience, and be preferably males.


Salary
N100,000 - N120,000 monthly.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Inventory Officer Job at Max Drive




        
    

        
        Max Drive - We are a team of passionate people and a leading technology-enabled company driven by a vision to solve the mobility challenges in Africa. We want to get people and goods to their destinations hitch-free. It is personal for us because we understand the frustration of epileptic transportation. We are making mobility safe, affordable, accessible, and sustainable through the deployment of high-performance technologies and operators.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Inventory Officer

Job Location: Osogbo, Osun

Role Overview
     

            
    




	The Ideal Inventory Officer will ensure proper inventory management, proper safekeeping of stock items, accuracy and effectiveness of stock reordering and stock level maintenance. Prepare and submit daily/weekly/monthly stock usage reports.


Key Responsibilities


	Receiving of new stocks and proper stock taking both physically and on the ERP platform and the relevant sheet
	Issuance of parts to refurbishment team and proper documentation of parts issued out
	Issuance of engine oil for maintenance, and documentation on ERP platform and the relevant sheet
	Monitor reorder level and determine reorder quantity of stock items by evaluating and analyzing internal customers request patterns.
	Weekly review of stock level & initiation for replenishment on Odoo to maintain optimal and timely availability of stocks.
	Monitor stock movement and conduct regular stock counts to reconcile discrepancies.
	Raising of requests on Odoo for purchase of parts and other items used by the fleet/refurbishment team.
	Analyze and monitor request trends to identify fast moving and slow moving stock.
	This will help avoid tying down funds.
	Carry out any other task assigned.


Requirements


	A Degree in Finance, Accounting, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or any relevant fields, Minimum of a Bsc/HND.
	2-3+ years of experience in mechanical, technical, fleet operational and inventory roles
	Experience in startups, mobility, fintech, logistics, marketplaces, or tech-enabled businesses is strongly preferred.
	Proficient in MS Office/Google Workspace.
	Good Maths SkillsCritical and analytical thinking.
	Experience working with performance marketing, CRM, lifecycle marketing, and analytics tools.


Skills & Competencies:


	Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
	Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and data visualization tools.
	Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
	Strong execution discipline with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
	Commercially minded with strong business acumen.

Maritime, Shipping & Energy Lawyer Job at Tetra Maritime




        
    

        
        Founded in 2007 (originally as Beta Shipping), Tetra Maritime is a Nigerian ship owner and operator specializing in tailored marine logistics across the upstream, midstream, and downstream oil & gas supply chain. With a fleet of Nigerian-flagged vessels operating across the African continent, and a strategic partnership with Union Maritime, a UK-based ship owner with global acclaim, we are committed to delivering end-to-end logistics solutions to our clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Maritime, Shipping & Energy Lawyer

Job Location: Lagos

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a highly organised and detail oriented Junior Compliance professionals with experience in some or all of the following, to support the Group’s global governance, compliance, and corporate administration activities:
	
		Corporate administration;
		Corporate governance and entity management;
		Corporate restructuring;
		Regulatory filings & deadline management;
		KYC and compliance;
		Company secretarial support.
	
	


Key Responsibilities


	Support statutory filings and corporate registry submissions across multiple jurisdictions (UK, Singapore, Bermuda, India, etc.) and prepare required corporate documentation; 
	Assist with entity management and corporate administration for a global SPV portfolio; 
	Draft board minutes, written resolutions, and maintain statutory registers and corporate records; 
	Conduct KYC / AML onboarding and compliance checks on third parties; 
	Prepare and provide KYC documentation and group structure charts to banks, counterparties, and service providers; 
	Coordinate cross?border incorporations, dissolutions, and corporate changes; 
	Support intragroup restructurings; 
	Maintain departmental trackers, databases, and filing systems; 
	Liaise with banks, auditors, legal counsel, and corporate service providers; 
	Provide general administrative, compliance, and CoSec support to the legal team. 


Requirements


	At least 1 year of  experience in a legal, compliance, corporate services, or financial services environment (experience in shipping, commodities, finance, or SPVheavy groups is an advantage). 
	Exposure to some or all of the following: 
	
		Company secretarial; 
		Statutory filings & corporate registry submission 
		Corporate authorities & board documentation 
		KYC and compliance; 
		Crossborder corporate changes and restructurings 
		Interaction with ship registries or overseas registries (advantageous) 
		Joint ventures and other corporate matters. 
	
	


Key attributes:


	Strong drafting and document preparation skills 
	High level of organization and attention to detail 
	Ability to work with energy, agility, and resilience across multiple fast?moving matters 
	Excellent interpersonal skills and confidence liaising with internal teams and external stakeholders 
	Strong project?management mindset and ability to track multiple deadlines 
	Reliable document management and record?keeping skills; 


Benefits


	This is a unique opportunity to be part of a high-impact team at the heart of the business.
	The role offers exposure to strategic decision-making and the potential for career progression within the organization.
